items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Her name is Angelina Stevenson Campbell. She was a Jollibee.

ctx.x: You had a lot of musicians coming in.

Oh yeah. Oh yeah, yeah. And my aunt, one of my aunts played piano. And she taught at school. She was also, she always so became a principal. As a matter of fact, I just found out that she is the first black female, American, to graduate from Columbia University. Wow. Yeah. Her name is Angelina Stevenson Campbell. She was a Jollibee. And she used to be principal of a couple of high schools here. So she's still living. She's 93 years old now. She's. Yeah. And so, I can't think of the alto man's name, you know, like…
Local guy? Local, from New Orleans?
